With the rapid rise of OpenClaw, integrating it into enterprise workflows to boost productivity has become an urgent need for many companies. On March 13, Tencent Cloud's Intelligent Agent Development Platform upgraded its "Enterprise-Grade OpenClaw" solution (ADP Claw). By launching five major security firewalls, a rich array of specialized plugins, and industry best-practice workflows, it ensures both security and usability, helping enterprises seamlessly incorporate OpenClaw into their business environments to enhance productivity.  

Building five "firewalls" to equip the "claw" with a full-chain "safety vault"  

As a dedicated OpenClaw solution for enterprises, security is the core advantage of Tencent Cloud's ADP Claw. ADP Claw has established five security "firewalls" covering the entire chain, providing comprehensive "safety vault" protection for enterprise-grade AI agents.  

First is model invocation and execution security. Through a unified security gateway, strict control is enforced based on Agent identity to prevent unauthorized access; full-chain logs of model invocations are recorded to support security audits and issue tracing; real-time monitoring and interception of abnormal invocation behaviors are implemented, with rate-limiting mechanisms ensuring platform stability and defending against malicious attacks and resource abuse.  

Second is dialogue input and output security. On the input side, real-time detection and interception of direct Prompt injection attacks are performed; indirect Prompt injection attacks triggered by Agents browsing web pages or reading files are guarded against; sensitive information in user inputs is identified and filtered.

In 2026, as China's low-altitude economy transitions from "pilot flights" to "regular operations," a technological revolution driven by artificial intelligence and embodied intelligence is reshaping the skies. From March 12 to 15, the highly anticipated "RortiX Dream Fly – Wings Unfold a New Chapter, X Leads the Skies" event grandly opened at the Sky Universe in Hall E7 of the Shanghai New International Expo Center. During this four-day technological feast, RortiX, a rising international consumer tech brand from China, not only delivered a visual spectacle but also announced to the world the official arrival of an AI-defined era of low-altitude flight.

Evolving from a "participant" to a "definer" of low-altitude flight, RortiX has upgraded its product technology R&D, restructured its brand portfolio and product lines under the "AI+" future theme, and chosen AWE as the global launch stage. This injects the dual brilliance of AI and embodied intelligence into the premier exhibition, turning Hall E7 into the "first experiential site" for future aerial intelligence.

I. National Aspiration: Defining the Future of Flight  
At the 2026 China Appliance & Consumer Electronics Expo, Dreame showcased its robust capabilities and achievements in product R&D, market operations, and capital backing across the entire Hall E7. On the morning of March 12, Hall E7 was bustling with global tech enthusiasts, industry experts, and investment representatives gathered at the "Sky Universe" exhibition area to witness the RortiX-themed event, "RortiX Dream Fly – Wings Unfold a New Chapter, X Leads the Skies."
excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando 2026 se convierte en el año inaugural de la transición de la economía de baja altitud de China desde "vuelos piloto" hacia "operaciones regulares", una revolución tecnológica impulsada por la inteligencia artificial y la inteligencia corporeizada está remodelando el cielo. Del 12 al 15 de marzo, el evento temático "RortiX Dream Fly - Desplegando Nuevos Capítulos, X Liderando el Cielo", altamente anticipado a nivel global, se inauguró espléndidamente en el Centro de Exposiciones Internacional de Shanghai, Pabellón E7 de Dreami, Universo Celestial. Durante este festín tecnológico de cuatro días, RortiX, la nueva estrella internacional de productos tecnológicos de consumo que ha ganado gran popularidad en China en los últimos años, no solo ofreció un impacto visual, sino que también anunció al mundo la llegada oficial de una era de vuelo de baja altitud definida por la IA.
